name: omni-tools-enhanced
description: Enhanced and independently developed edition of iib0011/omni-tools: fixes the search user-type filter bug (#227), adds Unit Converter + Data Transfer Time tools, and ships a zero-dependency MCP server exposing the tool logic to AI agents (Claude Desktop / Cursor).

paragraphs: An enhanced, independently maintained edition of omni-tools — a self-hosted collection of 130+ free, privacy-first browser tools — adding a fix for a real search-filter bug, two new tools, a zero-dependency MCP server that exposes the tool logic to AI agents, and a fork-appropriate CI pipeline.

Enhancement and independent development based on open-source technology (Mode B). This fork keeps upstream's MIT license and full attribution. The web UI, the existing 130+ tools and the general architecture are unchanged upstream code; the improvements listed below are the work of George Nakisisa / GICT Africa Technologies. See Attribution.
Live demo (GitHub Pages) · Upstream project · Upstream demo
features: Correctness — fixes upstream issue #227: the homepage search results ignored the user-type filter (general users / developers), including a filter restored from localStorage on reload.
New tools — a multi-category Unit Converter (upstream issue #79) and a Data Transfer Time Calculator (upstream issue #80), both directly useful in bandwidth- and data-cost-constrained environments.

AI agent access — a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes the same pure service functions the web UI uses to any MCP client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, …). One source of truth, two consumers — no logic…
#227 (bug) — users who select the "developers" filter still see general-user tools in search results, because Hero.tsx only recomputed the filtered list on text-input changes.
#79 (feature, 7 comments) — a general unit converter was frequently requested; only a byte/data converter existed.

requirements.text: No configuration or API keys are required.
